Tagged in OpenStreetMap as a deli, it appears to be a neighbourhood food shop that may carry grab-and-go items useful to cyclists passing through. Nanaimo is a key hub on Vancouver Island cycling routes, making street-level food stops like this potentially valuable to touring riders.
